items.claim: Gage Young makes up for his poor defense with his durability.
items.quote: Gage Young to me is like quite well-rounded and where he sucks, his defense, he makes up for with his durability.

items.claim: Gage Young's get-up game has improved significantly recently, making him hard to keep down.
items.quote: Gage Young's get up game is very good. Uh, he improved it actually. It was actually a lot worse couple years ago, but his get up game has improved very like very well recently. He's getting up and hard to keep down, hard to finish.
